deepseek-copilot.walkthrough.title: Responses models for Copilot Chat
deepseek-copilot.walkthrough.description: Configure the user-supplied GPT 6.1 Sol Responses endpoint.
deepseek-copilot.walkthrough.setApiKey.d:
Use credentials from your configured Responses provider. Keys are stored in VS Code SecretStorage. The legacy Get API Key command still links to DeepSeek.
[Set API Key](command:deepseek-copilot.setApiKey)
Choose GPT 6.1 Sol in Copilot Chat. If hidden, show it under the DeepSeek provider in the Language Models manager.
[Open Language Models](command:workbench.action.chat.manage)
deepseek-copilot.walkthrough.advancedSet:
Configure the Responses URL, model capabilities and token bounds, reasoning effort, and cache key.
[Open settings](command:deepseek-copilot.openSettings)
deepseek-copilot.config.title: DeepSeek Copilot
deepseek-copilot.config.baseUrl.descript:
Responses base URL or full endpoint. Default: https://gd.yundu.lol/v1/responses (user supplied). A trailing /responses is kept; otherwise /responses is appended. Include /v1 where your service needs it. Chat Completions is not supported. [Reset to Default](command:deepseek-copilot.resetBaseUrl)

[Set / Update API Key](command:deepseek-copilot.setApiKey) · [Clear API Key](command:deepseek-copilot.clearApiKey)
deepseek-copilot.config.requestHeaders.d: Custom headers for Responses requests. Use Set API Key for credentials instead of putting them in settings.
deepseek-copilot.config.maxTokens.descri: Output token cap. 0 uses the model profile limit; a positive integer further limits output without exceeding maxOutputTokens. The picker shows the effective cap.
deepseek-copilot.config.experimental.sta:
**Experimental**: try to pre-activate available tools to reduce changes across turns. May increase input tokens and internal preflight calls. Any cache improvement depends on your backend. Disabled by default.

[Configure Tools](command:workbench.action.chat.configureTools)
deepseek-copilot.config.debugMode.descri:
Controls what diagnostic information DeepSeek Copilot writes. Token usage is always reported to Copilot regardless of this setting.

- **Minimal** — Token usage only. No diagnostic logs or request dumps.
- **Metadata** — Privacy-safe diagnostic metadata (request hashes, prefix overlap, tool schema changes). Does not contain prompt text — safe to share in public issue reports. View with [`DeepSeek: Show Logs`](command:deepseek-copilot.showLogs).
- **Verbose** — Complete request payloads written to disk for local debugging. **Warning: contains sensitive prompt content.** View with [`DeepSeek: Open Request Dumps Folder`](command:deepseek-copilot.openRequestDumpsFolder).
deepseek-copilot.config.debugMode.minima: Token usage only. No diagnostic logs or dumps.
deepseek-copilot.config.debugMode.metada: Privacy-safe metadata. Safe to share publicly. View with `DeepSeek: Show Logs`.
deepseek-copilot.config.debugMode.verbos: ⚠️ Contains sensitive prompt content. For local debugging only.
deepseek-copilot.config.visionModel.desc: Retained Vision Proxy setting. The default GPT 6.1 Sol profile uses native image input and needs no proxy.
deepseek-copilot.config.visionPrompt.des: Retained Vision Proxy description prompt. Does not affect Responses models configured for native image input.
deepseek-copilot.config.models.descripti: Replace the selectable model list. The default GPT 6.1 Sol profile is user supplied; capabilities and limits are not independently verified public model specifications. Enable only capabilities your backend supports. Set [] to hide every model.
deepseek-copilot.config.models.contextWi: Optional total input-plus-output context bound. The effective output allowance is reserved before deriving the input budget, capped by maxInputTokens.
deepseek-copilot.config.models.canDisabl: Set true only when the backend explicitly supports the none reasoning effort. Disabling reasoning is not offered by default.
deepseek-copilot.config.promptCacheKey.d: Responses prompt_cache_key. auto generates a stable hash without prompt plaintext; an empty string omits the field; any other string is used as the key. Cache hits and pricing depend on your backend.
deepseek-copilot.config.modelIdOverrides: Override the API ID for any configured model. Keys are picker model IDs; values are model names sent to the endpoint. This does not add models or change capability limits.
